record.original_question:
Let A ∈ GL_n(R) be invertible and let Γ ⊂ R^n be a full rank lattice. For ψ ∈ L2(R^n), define ψ_{j,k}(x) := |det A|^{j/2} ψ(A^j x − k) for j ∈ Z and k ∈ Γ. Call ψ an orthonormal wavelet associated with (A,Γ) if {ψ_{j,k} : j ∈ Z, k ∈ Γ} is an orthonormal basis of L2(R^n).

For what dilations A and lattices Γ does there exist an orthonormal wavelet associated with (A,Γ)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A \in GL_n(\mathbb{R})$ be an invertible $n \times n$ real matrix and let $\Gamma \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a full rank lattice (that is, $\Gamma = P\mathbb{Z}^n$ for some $P \in GL_n(\mathbb{R})$). For a function $\psi \in L^2(\mathbb{R}^n)$ and integers $j \in \mathbb{Z}$, $k \in \Gamma$, define the dilated and translated function
$$\psi_{j,k}(x) := |\det A|^{j/2}\, \psi(A^j x - k), \qquad x \in \mathbb{R}^n.$$
Call $\psi$ an orthonormal wavelet associated with the pair $(A, \Gamma)$ if the family
$$\{\psi_{j,k} : j \in \mathbb{Z},\ k \in \Gamma\}$$
forms an orthonormal basis of $L^2(\mathbb{R}^n)$.

Characterize all pairs $(A, \Gamma)$, with $A \in GL_n(\mathbb{R})$ and $\Gamma \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ a full rank lattice, for which there exists an orthonormal wavelet associated with $(A, \Gamma)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The general characterization remains open. For expanding dilations the existence problem is well understood, but for non-expanding dilations the question is tied to a delicate lattice counting estimate involving the eigenvectors of A relative to Γ, and is only resolved in special cases (e.g. dimension 1 fully, partial results in higher dimensions). Recent works (2017–2025) provide partial results but no complete characterization.

status_evidence.snippet: Problem 3.1. For what dilations A ∈ GLn(R) and lattices Γ ⊂ Rn, there exist an orthonormal wavelet associated with (A, Γ)?

status_evidence.title: Wavelets for Non-expanding Dilations and the Lattice Counting Estimate
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and characterization of wavelets for non-expanding dilations are intimately connected with a bound on the number of lattice points in balls dilated by powers of A.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial progress for non-expanding dilations.

status_evidence.title: On the existence of wavelets for non-expansive dilation matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of orthonormal wavelets for non-expansive dilation matrices, partial results.
